families.label: Talismans
families.note: Death talisman is skipped - not a card in this dataset. Elemental and Catalytic talismans are combination talismans sharing Runecraft levels 1 and 2 with Air and Mind, but each gets its own tier rather than sharing a rung.

families.label: Ancient blood ornament kit
families.note: Applies to all three Torva armour pieces to make the Sanguine torva recolour, which is not a card in this dataset - the crafted result stays outside the unlock set, so the product-boundary caveat fires generically.

families.label: Amulet of eternal glory
families.note: Its own branch - foiling Amulet of eternal glory unlocks Amulet of Glory but not Dragonstone amulet, per the maintainer.

families.label: Teleport tablets
families.note: Ordered by Construction level to make, per the OSRS Wiki. Trollheim teleport is not a card in this dataset, so it's skipped.

families.label: Mixology potions
families.note: Ordered by Herblore level, per the Guardians of the Rift/Mastering Mixology point table.

families.label: Tiaras
families.note: Ordered by Crafting XP to make, per the OSRS Wiki. A foil unlocks the wear verb on that tier and below - each tiara still needs a Tiara and the matching talisman to craft.

families.label: Ancient artefacts
families.note: Ordered by coin value, per the OSRS Wiki artefact table.

families.label: Vambraces
families.note: Gilded d'hide vambraces and Hueycoatl hide vambraces are excluded - checked against the OSRS Wiki and neither matches the Black d'hide/3rd age tier cleanly, so they're left out rather than guessed in.

families.label: Mage hats
families.note: Ordered by Magic attack bonus per the OSRS Wiki. Ahrim's hood, Zuriel's hood, and Dagon'hai hat excluded - boss/GWD items, not part of this generic progression.

families.label: Mage robe tops
families.note: Ordered by Magic attack bonus per the OSRS Wiki. No wizard-tier robe top exists as a card in this dataset.

families.label: Mage robe bottoms
families.note: Ordered by Magic attack bonus per the OSRS Wiki.

families.label: Wands
families.note: Ordered by Magic level to wield, per the OSRS Wiki. Dragon hunter wand and 3rd age wand tie at 65 Magic - each still gets its own tier rather than sharing a rung.

families.label: Potions
families.note: Non-drinkable herblore products (poultices/dressings, oils, weapon poisons, compost potion) and Divine-tier potions are deliberately excluded. A foil unlocks the use verb on that tier and below - each potion still needs its own ingredients to make.

families.label: Potion mixes
families.note: A foil unlocks the use verb on every mix at this tier and below - each mix still needs its own ingredients to make.

families.label: Tree seeds
families.note: Regular trees only - fruit tree and hardwood tree seeds are separate and get their own ladders when the alphabetical item pass reaches them.
